title: Introduce test/helpers/pump_app.dart — 6 gamification test files hand-roll near-identical MaterialApp/ProviderScope boilerplate
why: docs/coding-standards.md:462-465 (TQ-3) names `test/helpers/pump_app.dart` as 'the reviewed convention' for this exact ProviderScope+localization-delegate boilerplate, but the file doesn't exist anywhere in the repo (confirmed via ls test/helpers/). In this batch alone, child_redemption_screen_l1_test.dart (_pumpScreen + _pumpScreenWithRouter), gamification_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildApp), parent_pending_redemptions_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildScreen + buildWithRouter), reward_configuration_screen_l1_test.dart (_buildFake), streak_widget_test.dart (buildWidget) and achievement_unlock_celebration_test.dart (_buildHarness) each reimplement the same ~20-30 line scaffold independently; achievement_unlock_celebration_test.dart even duplicates its own _buildHarness body inline twice (lines 272-294 and 297-319) instead of calling it, showing the drift risk in practice — any future fix to the shared scaffold (e.g. a new required delegate) must be hand-applied at every site.
recommendation: Create test/helpers/pump_app.dart per the standards doc and migrate these builders to call it, parameterizing only the feature-specific overrides.
acceptance_criteria: The 6 cited builder functions delegate to it instead of duplicating MaterialApp/localizationsDelegates/ProviderScope setup.
